snippet.title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight releases September 18, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/lego-batman-legacy-of-the-dark-knight-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

In LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm.

Deluxe Edition owners will receive the Mayhem Collection DLC featuring The Joker and Harley Quinn! It includes a new Story Mission, Mayhem Mode, and a villain-themed Sinister Pack.

#NintendoDirect #LEGOBatmanGame

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
